_about: Keys Angelo never accepts in a verified TLS chain and never ships in a trust store: each key's DER subjectPublicKeyInfo (base64) and its SHA-256 (hex), and its certificate's subject Name contents (base64; a compiled-in trust anchor stores both). Read by tls_distrust.py (every Angelo TLS context) and scripts/angelo/trust_store.py (release check). Source: the eMudhra disclosure of 2026-10-20 (Mozilla bug 2083449; certifi GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2); the certificates are in tests/python/angelo_agent/tls_distrust_fixtures.
